mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact bounded auxiliary Fourier/symplectic physical traces, full scalar/traceless support grading, positional-mask exclusion, torus moments, character unitarity and reversed-kernel structure.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact integers and rational numbers; cyclotomic polynomial quotient; Laurent constant coefficients.
mathematics.conventions: Ordinary unnormalized Hilbert-Schmidt trace; physical-word Hamming mask; one full slot cycle; common torus variable across all slots.

bounds.binary_masks: all masks with <=floor(m/2) q positions for 2<=m<=16
bounds.full_support_trace: N=2,m=4,16 support masks,all physical double indices
bounds.symplectic_character_checks: n=3,5,9,15; both frequency multipliers 1,2; all differences and summation labels
bounds.second_phase_moments: n=3,5,9;all nonzero translations and all ordered label pairs

non_claims: No universal theorem follows merely from these finite checks.
No actual-BGS counterexample, exact quantization claim, or general universality result.
Separate fixed-fraction theorem and actual semiclassical estimates are not audited.
